subject: Kiosk override + merge rules for on-floor badge sync
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@eventco.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: EventCo Ops <ops@eventco.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Aug 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Issues with duplicate leads & manual kiosk overrides at Summer Summit

Hi Rishi,

We had a couple of oddities on the show floor during Saturday's Summer Summit. The kiosk team reported that when they used the "Manual Override" flow on a badge scan (for attendees who wanted to opt out of automatic transfer), the scanned record sometimes created a duplicate in HubSpot instead of attaching to the existing contact. I attached the scanner logs from 8/18.

Quick details:
- Scanners: 12 kiosks, model XY-92, firmware 3.1.0
- Symptom: Manual override leads to a new contact instead of merging with existing email-based match
- Example attendee: julie.watson@example.org (created duplicate at 10:47am)

We need guidance on whether this is a mapping/rules issue or a race condition during sync. Our ops lead is anxious — they want a short-term workaround for tomorrow's follow-up batch and a longer-term fix. Can your team prioritize?

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Head of Event Operations
EventCo Productions

[attachment: scanner-logs-0818.csv]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@eventco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Aug 2025 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Issues with duplicate leads & manual kiosk overrides at Summer Summit

Hi Samantha — thanks for the fast note and the logs. Sorry this hit you during the event.

Quick read: initial guess is a conflict between the kiosk "override" flow (which writes a temporary UID) and our dedupe rule that favors incoming badge email when the contact already exists but hasn't fully synced across our queue.

Planned immediate actions:
1) Ben, can you confirm whether the badge UID sometimes arrives before the contact email resolution and whether our hubspot upsert key is currently set to email-only or to a composite (email + badge_id)?
2) For EventCo ops: if you can pause the manual override for the next inbound batch, we can run a targeted de-dup job and then re-enable.

I'll loop Marissa for runbook updates so this doesn't recur.

— Rishi
Product Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha@eventco.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Aug 2025 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Issues with duplicate leads & manual kiosk overrides at Summer Summit

Rishi / Lauren — dug into the logs: you can see sequences where the kiosk writes badge_id B-XY-340 then our consumer picks up two events for the same badge in <1s: a scan event and a manual_override event. The upsert path currently prefers badge_id when present, and HubSpot mapping uses email as the primary identifier; that mismatch is exactly what creates a new contact if the email hasn't yet arrived in the same window.

Notes and quick fixes:
- Temporary: change the upsert to prefer email over badge_id for 24 hours. That will make manual overrides attach to existing contacts when email exists. I can push this change to staging and to prod with a 15-minute deploy window.
- Permanent: implement a composite resolution step on consumer that holds an incoming badge event for 500ms to see if an associated email arrives (race buffer).

Attached a short doc with proposed merge-rules and the sample query I ran.

Ben
Lead Integration Engineer
Redwood Inference

[attachment: merge-rules-v2.docx]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha@eventco.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Aug 2025 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Issues with duplicate leads & manual kiosk overrides at Summer Summit

Thanks for the breakdown. Operationally we need two things from engineering before we tell EventCo to re-enable manual overrides:
1) The 24-hour email-preference toggle deployed and smoke-tested (Ben)
2) A short doc for EventCo ops with the temporary SOP and how we will run the de-dup job (Marissa, can you draft?)

Marissa — can you own the SOP and include clear instructions for the de-dupe job (time window, expected downtime, rollback)? I want to send a crisp one-page note to Samantha with ETA.

Also copying HubSpot admin contact in the follow-up link so they can accept our integration update.

Lauren
Director, Field Marketing Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@eventco.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Aug 2025 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Issues with duplicate leads & manual kiosk overrides at Summer Summit

Samantha — sending the short runbook and timeline below. We'll take the following steps tonight (window: 11pm–12am PDT):

Short-runbook (one pager):
- PRE-WINDOW: Pause manual override in all kiosks (EventCo ops). Confirm pause via Slack.
- DEPLOY: Ben will flip upsert preference to email-first (15m deploy + smoke).
- DEDUPE JOB: Run targeted merge for 8/18 08:00–18:00 (de-dup script attached; expected merges ~120–160). We will snapshot HubSpot contacts and store a rollback CSV.
- VALIDATE: Sample 20 merged contacts and confirm opt-in flags preserved.
- RE-ENABLE: If validation passes, EventCo ops can re-enable manual override at 12:05am PDT.

Post-mitigation permanent plan (summary): composite resolution (500ms buffer) + add badge_id as secondary identifier in an ancillary field in HubSpot rather than primary upsert key. Full design doc to follow next week.

ETA: deploy + de-dupe tonight; follow-up summary email with rollback CSV by 8/22 10:00am PDT.

Attachments: merge-rules-v2.docx, scanner-logs-0818.csv

Thanks — Marissa
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
